## Fixed
- Tapping the artist in the music player now lets you pick any credited artist, not only the first (#1638)
- The notification keeps a song's artwork during long background listening, retrying when the network drops (#1637)
- Starting a device sync whose code had expired no longer crashes Flow (#1639)
- Playlists imported from Metrolist now show artist names; importing again fixes playlists already imported (#1619)
- Search no longer freezes on slower devices, and crash reports, Diagnostics and About work on Android 8 (#1635)
- A video download that falls back to the backup method, or resumes, keeps the audio track you chose (#1634)
- YouTube Mixes in search results no longer show "0 videos"
